payment.cardFeeNote: {percent}% fee on the amount to pay
payment.cancellation1: Maximum cancellation charge by notice period: 31 days or more, 10%; 16–30 days, 25%; 8–15 days, 50%; 3–7 days, 75%; 2 days or less or no-show, up to 100%.
payment.cancellation2: Machu Picchu tickets, Inca Trail permits, trains, flights and special-rate hotels may have their own conditions; we disclose them before payment.
payment.cancellation3: If we cancel, we offer rescheduling, an equivalent service or a full refund.
payment.holdNote: When you confirm, we hold your seats for 15 minutes while the payment is processed.
payment.terms: I have read and agree to the <payments>Booking & Cancellation Policy</payments>, the <terms>Terms & Conditions</terms> and any special conditions applicable to my booking, and I confirm I have read the <privacy>Privacy policy</privacy>.
payment.secureNote: Secure payment · You will receive your electronic receipt by email
payment.travelerDocsLater: Travelers: after booking we will ask you by WhatsApp or email for each traveler’s exact name and document to issue the tickets.
payment.currencyNational: Prices in soles (S/) with the rate for Peru residents.
payment.currencyForeign: Prices in US dollars (US$) with the rate for international travelers (country: {country}). If you live in Peru, change your country in “Your details”.
payment.howMuchRequest: How would you like to pay on confirmation?
payment.depositHelpRequest: We send you the payment instructions once availability is confirmed. The balance is paid before travelling.

hold.expiredShort: The time to pay ran out and we released your seats.
hold.expired: The time to pay ran out and we released your seats. Go back to your cart to check availability.
hold.holding: We are holding your seats for {time} more minutes.

sandbox.title: Sandbox mode: simulated payment, nothing will be charged
sandbox.text: The payment provider's secure form for {method} will appear here. Your card details go straight to the provider; Peru Wonders Tours does not store them.

whatsappBooking.note: For now we confirm bookings via WhatsApp. Pressing the button opens a chat with your request (tours, dates, travelers and amount) and we will tell you how to pay. Your spot is confirmed once we receive the payment.
whatsappBooking.sent: We opened WhatsApp with your request. Send the message and we will reply during business hours.

wetravel.note: Payment is made on WeTravel's secure page (credit or debit card). Press Pay to prepare your payment link.
wetravel.intro: Your payment link is ready. Open it, complete the payment on WeTravel, then come back here and press “I've paid”.
wetravel.notCompleted: We can't see your payment on WeTravel yet. If you already paid, wait a minute and press “I've paid” again; your booking is still on hold.

izipay.holderIntro: Izipay requires them to validate your {method} payment. When you press Pay, its secure window opens so you can enter your card or Yape.
izipay.postalCodeHint: Numbers only. If yours has letters, enter 00000.

errors.phone: Enter the mobile number with country code (7 to 15 digits).
errors.document: Check the number: DNI has 8 digits; passport or other, 8 to 12 letters or numbers.
errors.state: Enter the region or state (no numbers).

izipay.secure: Izipay processes the payment; Peru Wonders Tours never sees or stores your card details.
izipay.loadFailed: We could not open the Izipay payment window. Check your connection or turn off your ad blocker and try again. You were not charged.
izipay.notCompleted: The payment was not completed in Izipay. Your booking is still saved: you can try again.

payBooking.succeeded: Payment recorded. We updated your booking.
payBooking.connectionError: We could not reach the payment system. You were not charged; try again.
